feats.title: Anger Unleashed
feats.description: The first time you are bloodied during an encounter, you gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Savage Assault
feats.description: When you use furious assault, the enemy you hit also takes a -1 penalty to all defenses until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Thirst for Battle
feats.description: You gain a +3 feat bonus to initiative checks, and your number of healing surges increases by one.

feats.title: Unrelenting Assault
feats.description:
You can use your Furious Assault racial power when you miss an enemy with an attack. If the triggering attack deals half damage on a miss, the extra damage from your Furious Assault is not divided by half. If the triggering attack does not deal half damage on a miss, the triggering attack deals half damage to the triggering enemy on a miss.

Additionally, you gain a +2 feat bonus to Endurance checks. This feat bonus increases to +3 at 21st level.

feats.title: Vengeance!
feats.description: When you drop to 0 hit points or fewer you may make a free melee attack before gaining the dying condition.

feats.title: Pain Gain
feats.description: The first time you are bloodied during an encounter, you gain a +5 bonus to damage rolls until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Strong-Arm Tactics
feats.description: You gain a +2 feat bonus to Intimidate checks and you can use your Strength in place of your Charisma for Intimidate checks.
